messages:
Alex Cooper: Hey team — quick Q for where I should stash my ramp notes and which folks to add as editors. I started a page in my personal space but not sure if I should move it to "Platform / Onboarding / Ramp Notes" or to my team space. Also, which template do folks usually use?
Maria Chen: hi Alex — welcome! :wave: We generally ask new hires to duplicate the Ramp Notes template from the DevEx templates folder and keep a private copy for the first week, then move to the team folder once buddy review is done. Template link: https://notion.redwood/workspace/devex/templates/ramp-notes
Jamal Ortiz: Alex — I kept mine private for a few days and then shared with my manager + buddy. Makes edits less noisy. Add your manager and @Jamal Ortiz as editors and ping the doc owner when ready.
Ryan Patel: tagging from docs side — if you want us to set ACLs we can. Best practice: duplicate template, rename to "Lastname — Ramp Notes (Team)" and set the page property Owner = your manager, Status = "In review". Example path: Platform > Onboarding > New Hires > 2026 > Alex Cooper. I can pre-configure the page if you want.
Sophia Li: Also note naming conventions: prefix with YEAR and your initials if multiple hires overlap. And please use the #ramp-checkpoint template block inside the ramp notes for weekly goals.
Maria Chen: To request edit perms for a team folder you can use the Docs Access form (one-click): https://redwood.internal/forms/docs-access — pick the folder 'Platform / Onboarding / Ramp Notes' and list editors. The DevEx team monitors that daily.
DevEx Bot: Automated: Received docs-access request for folder 'Platform / Onboarding / Ramp Notes'. Ticket #DOC-4821. We'll update when ACLs are set.
Alex Cooper: Thanks all — I'll duplicate the template now, add Jamal + my manager, and submit the access form. Appreciate the help! :thumbsup:
Ryan Patel: If you want me to seed the page with the team kickoff checklist, say the word and I'll drop it in and set the properties.
Alex Cooper: That would be great — thanks Ryan :grin:
